_comment: Links grant recipients to organisations on the map when the names differ, for every funder in build/funding/. Values are map labels. by_title rules are checked first and need both the recipient and a title (or purpose) match, as a regular expression. build.py warns about any label that no longer exists. Every entry was checked by hand against the grant titles.
